# Inspector (`inspector`)

Collapsible parameter sections with sliders and keyframe toggles.

Group: Media & editors. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/media';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createInspector` (types in `dist/web/media/inspector.d.ts`): `.mh-inspector`: collapsible sections (native `<details>`: `__section`, `__summary` with `__title` and `__caret`, `__body`) of parameter rows (`__param--slider | --toggle | --choice`). Each row has an optional keyframe toggle (`__key`, `aria-pressed`, `.is-animated` when keyed elsewhere), a label and its control: a range (`.mh-slider__input`) with an exact number field (`__number`, `__unit`), a switch (`.mh-switch`), or a select.

```ts
export function createInspector(options: InspectorOptions): InspectorHandle;

export interface InspectorOptions {
  /** Accessible name of the panel ("Properties"). */
  label: string;
  sections: readonly InspectorSection[];
  /** A new value; `committed` is false while a slider is being dragged. */
  onChange?: (id: string, value: InspectorValue, committed: boolean) => void;
  /** The keyframe toggle was pressed; `on` is the new state at the current time. */
  onKeyframe?: (id: string, on: boolean) => void;
  onSectionToggle?: (id: string, open: boolean) => void;
}

export interface InspectorHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  setValue(id: string, value: InspectorValue): void;
  setKeyframe(id: string, state: KeyframeState): void;
  setOpen(sectionId: string, open: boolean): void;
}
```

`createText` (types in `dist/web/foundations/text.d.ts`): `.mh-text--<variant>`: the type scale at the current device class.

```ts
export function createText(content: Child, options: TextOptions = {}): HTMLElement;

export interface TextOptions {
  variant?: TextVariant;
  tone?: TextTone;
  /** Element to render; default `p`, or `h1`–`h3` for display, headline and title. */
  as?: keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createInspector, createText } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const status = createText('', { variant: 'caption', tone: 'muted' });

const inspector = createInspector({
  label: 'Clip properties',
  sections: [
    {
      id: 'transform',
      title: 'Transform',
      params: [
        { id: 'scale', kind: 'slider', label: 'Scale', value: 100, max: 400, unit: '%', keyframe: 'off' },
        { id: 'opacity', kind: 'slider', label: 'Opacity', value: 85, unit: '%', keyframe: 'on' },
      ],
    },
    {
      id: 'look',
      title: 'Look',
      params: [
        {
          id: 'blend',
          kind: 'choice',
          label: 'Blend',
          value: 'normal',
          options: [
            { value: 'normal', label: 'Normal' },
            { value: 'screen', label: 'Screen' },
          ],
        },
        { id: 'shadow', kind: 'toggle', label: 'Drop shadow', value: true },
      ],
    },
  ],
  // `committed` is false while a slider is being dragged.
  onChange: (id, value, committed) => committed && (status.textContent = `${id}: ${String(value)}`),
  onKeyframe: (id, on) => (status.textContent = `${id}: keyframe ${on ? 'added' : 'removed'}`),
});

document.body.append(inspector.el, status);
```

## React API

`Inspector` (types in `dist/react/media-editors.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createInspector`. Values follow the props; edits show at once and are reported.

```ts
export function Inspector({ label, sections, onChange, onKeyframe, onSectionToggle, className }: InspectorProps);

export interface InspectorProps {
  label: string;
  sections: readonly InspectorSection[];
  onChange?: (id: string, value: InspectorValue, committed: boolean) => void;
  onKeyframe?: (id: string, on: boolean) => void;
  onSectionToggle?: (id: string, open: boolean) => void;
  className?: string;
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Inspector } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { InspectorSection } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

export function InspectorExample() {
  const [scale, setScale] = useState(100);
  const [opacity, setOpacity] = useState(85);
  const [shadow, setShadow] = useState(true);
  const sections: InspectorSection[] = [
    {
      id: 'transform',
      title: 'Transform',
      params: [
        { id: 'scale', kind: 'slider', label: 'Scale', value: scale, max: 400, unit: '%', keyframe: 'off' },
        { id: 'opacity', kind: 'slider', label: 'Opacity', value: opacity, unit: '%', keyframe: 'on' },
      ],
    },
    { id: 'look', title: 'Look', params: [{ id: 'shadow', kind: 'toggle', label: 'Drop shadow', value: shadow }] },
  ];
  return (
    <Inspector
      label="Clip properties"
      sections={sections}
      onChange={(id, value) => {
        if (id === 'scale') setScale(Number(value));
        if (id === 'opacity') setOpacity(Number(value));
        if (id === 'shadow') setShadow(Boolean(value));
      }}
    />
  );
}
```
